crossRefs.note: “You shall make the robe of the ephod all of blue.

translations.web: He made the robe of the ephod of woven work, all of blue.
translations.bsb: They made the robe of the ephod entirely of blue cloth, the work of a weaver,
translations.kjv: And he made the robe of the ephod of woven work, all of blue.
translations.asv: And he made the robe of the ephod of woven work, all of blue.
